name: Ott's Masterwork
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
These are some truly fine materials, champion. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
narrative.objectives: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
narrative.offerRewardText: This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.Aka'Magosh, friend.
narrative.requestItemsText: My blade will not fail you, champion.
